name: PAiA Finance
description: Vertical pack for fiduciary financial planners, RIAs, and wealth advisors: 8 specialist personas (fiduciary investment advisor, tax-sensitive planner, estate planner, insurance & risk, retirement income, behavioral coach, RIA compliance officer, business-owner exit planner) bound to 4 reference knowledge stacks. FINRA/SEC/state-securities compliance posture; client data stays local by default. NOT a system that gives investment advice — outputs are draft work product for the licensed advisor.
